accent: Two accent levels per instrument key. Hold green ACCENT 1 or ACCENT 2 while striking a key (live, real-time or step write). Each key's accent level is an offset of up to +/-31 on the 0-31 voice level, clipped to 0..31 (Key Assign Job 05). The panel keys are not velocity-sensitive. External MIDI velocity can scale envelope parameters (MIDI Job 06 'E.G. Velocity').
global_features: 12 simultaneous sounds: each vertical key pair (A/M ... L/X) is one output channel that plays one sound at a time (manual); some secondary sources say 16-voice
24 internal 12-bit voices + 28 voices on the supplied RX5 ROM waveform cartridge + 12 RAM 'copied' voices = 64 addressable

Key Assign mode: assign voices per key; per-key pitch/level/attack/decay offsets; Multi Voice (one voice across the 12 top-row keys with graded parameters); Multi Step; 3 stored key-data sets ('drum sets')
Swing 54/58/63/67/71% (off = 50%), only with quantize 1/8 or 1/16; quantize to 1/48 or off (MT review)
Pattern edit: 5 parameters per individual note (pitch, level, envelope, reverse, etc.)
100 patterns (up to 99 bars), 20 songs (up to 999 parts), 3 chains; tempo 40-250; song tempo and volume changes; time signatures with denominators 1/2-1/32
Outputs: stereo L/MONO + R with fixed per-channel pan (ch1-12: 8,9,9,12,10,6,4,13,3,11,5,8 on a 15=L ... 1=R scale), 12 individual outs, click out, phones; 12 INSTRUMENT VOLUME faders
MIDI In/Out/Thru: Note Number mode (default map) and Tunable Note mode (a voice played chromatically C1-C6 per MIDI channel); per-voice MIDI transmit channel
Sync: internal, MIDI, tape, external clock in/out; footswitch start/stop; RAM4 data cartridge and cassette storage
Damp: in real-time write, a second key press (or MIDI note-off) cuts a ringing note

accent: Per note: hold the green ACCENT button while striking an instrument (live, real-time write or step write). Each instrument has an ACCENT LEVEL 00-31 that is added to its INST LEVEL (e.g. 15 + 05 = 20). Accent is stored per pattern; levels, pan and accent levels are stored per song.
global_features: 16 instrument buttons, 29 voices (8 snares, 4 toms, 3 bass drums, 2 open + 2 closed + 1 pedal hi-hat, ride, crash, 2 cowbells, 2 rimshots, 2 claps, shaker)
No per-voice tuning (E&MM: 'lack of user-tunability')
Per-instrument pan (15 discrete positions, active in STEREO OUT mode), level 00-31 and accent level 00-31
Swing 50 (off)/54/58/63/67/71%, real-time write only, quantize 1/8 or 1/16
Quantize 1/4-1/192; flams possible in real time at 1/192 (E&MM)
100 patterns (up to 99 bars), 10 songs, 255 parts, chain play, tempo changes
10 individual outs (COWBELL, CLAPS, SHAKER, TOM1, TOM2, BD, SD/RM, HH, CRASH, RIDE); in INDIVIDUAL OUT mode the L/R jacks become TOM4/TOM3; per-instrument stereo on/off
MIDI In/Out: note numbers assignable 36-99, per-instrument MIDI transmit channel, 24 ppqn clock (external sync 24/48/96 ppqn per E&MM)
RAM-1 data cartridge slot, cassette, footswitch; 2-digit LED plus 16-character LCD
Sample resolution is disputed: 8-bit per E&MM Mar 1984 and soundprogramming, 12-bit per SampleScience

Lower octaves for kicks and toms. Upper octaves for snares and hand claps', Gate Rev); SQ*Devol (8.6: 'Rap drums'); SQ*Wrapa (8.4: 'Rap percussion')
AWM 128 waves (12-bit per one source, 16-bit per the specs) + 256 FM waves; vector control of element level and detune via joystick
32-note polyphony (a 2-element voice such as DR:Kit gives about 16 notes, inferred); 16-part multitimbral Multi mode with per-channel note shift, detune, pan and output group
Two stereo output pairs (OUTPUT 1 and OUTPUT 2); effects apply only to OUTPUT 1
Voice-wide edits only: element wave, volume, pan, velocity sensitivity, LFO; voice envelope AR/RR offsets; pitch-bend range 0-12; wheel and aftertouch routing; no per-key drum editing documented
No sequencer; MIDI In/Out/Thru; MCD32/MCD64 cards (SY22 cards compatible per synthmania)
Hi-hat choke/exclusive group: none documented (unknown)

MIDI note numbers assume Yamaha naming (C3 = 60, so C1 = 36, C6 = 96). Inferred: the DR:Kit's middle keys match the RX5/RX11 defaults note-for-note (HH closed A2 = 57, HH open B2 = 59, Crash C3 = 60, Cup D3 = 62, Ride D#3 = 63)
